- **Google Hotels** — google.com/travel/hotels
- **Expedia** — expedia.com
- **Booking.com** — booking.com
- **Direct hotel chains** (Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, etc.) — be sure to log in with your **Gold tier membership** to access your perks and rates

### Rental Cars at SEA-TAC

- **Rentalcars.com** — rentalcars.com

> 💡 **Tip**: Since you mentioned you're a Gold tier customer, booking directly through the hotel chain or rental car company's website/app will usually ensure your loyalty benefits (upgrades, points, etc.) are properly applied.

I'm sorry I can't do more on this front! If you have any **coding or software development** questions, I'm happy to help.
